cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
s = open('refmodel.py').read()
start = s.index("        total = sum(it[2] for it in items)")
end = s.index("    # NI bitmaps/arrays in random node order")
new = '''        total = sum(it[2] for it in items)
        twos = [it for it in items if it[2] >= 2]
        ones = [it for it in items if it[2] == 1]
        rng.shuffle(twos)
        rng.shuffle(ones)
        pos = 0
        placed = []
        ti = 0
        oi = 0
        while ti < len(twos) or oi < len(ones):
            take_pair = (oi + 2 <= len(ones)) and (ti >= len(twos) or rng.random() < 0.3)
            if take_pair:
                placed.append((ones[oi], pos)); pos += 1
                placed.append((ones[oi + 1], pos)); pos += 1
                oi += 2
            elif ti < len(twos):
                placed.append((twos[ti], pos)); pos += 2
                ti += 1
            else:
                placed.append((ones[oi], pos)); pos += 1
                oi += 1
        assert pos == total, "layout size"
        for it, p in placed:
'''
new += '''            if it[0] == 'bulk':
                for i, c in enumerate(it[1]):
                    c.cell = p + 2 * i
                    c.slot = 2
            else:
                it[1].cell = p
                it[1].slot = 1 if it[2] == 1 else 2

'''
s = s[:start] + new + s[end:]
open('refmodel.py','w').write(s)
EOF
